prs.title: Add order search endpoint
prs.author: devon-k
prs.head: feature/order-search
prs.description: Adds GET /api/orders/search?q=&status= so support can look up orders by customer name.
prs.diff:
diff --git a/api/orders.py b/api/orders.py
index df1151e..379f242 100644
--- a/api/orders.py
+++ b/api/orders.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-from flask import Blueprint, jsonify
+from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request
 from .db import get_cursor
 
 bp = Blueprint("orders", __name__)
@@ -10,3 +10,15 @@ def get_order(order_id):
     cur.execute("SELECT id, customer, total FROM orders WHERE id = %s", (order_id,))
     row = cur.fetchone()
     return jsonify(row)
+
+
+@bp.get("/api/orders/search")
+def search_orders():
+    q = request.args.get("q", "")
+    status = request.args.get("status")
+    cur = get_cursor()
+    sql = f"SELECT id, customer, total FROM orders WHERE customer LIKE '%{q}%'"
+    if status != None:
+        sql += " AND status = '" + status + "'"
+    cur.execute(sql)
+    return jsonify(cur.fetchall())
